A routine day can turn into a wild adventure when unexpected animals show up! From snakes appearing in unusual places to stubborn turtles, sneaky raccoons and elusive mink, Turtleman and Neal James never know what their next call will bring. Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, takes on a series of unpredictable wildlife rescue and animal capture missions, where every new creature brings a different challenge.
Watch Call of the Wildman, Season 2, Episodes 5, 6, 1 and 20; Season 4, Episodes 2, 3 and 1, on Animal Planet India.
